landing.eyebrow: Risk, fraud and regulatory intelligence for Indian banking
landing.headline: Turn regulatory circulars into checks that
landing.subhead: KAVACH reads RBI-style circulars and compiles them into monitoring rules your team approves, finds mule rings and financial-crime typologies in the transaction data, and hands you an audit-ready evidence pack for every case.

stats.title: What is running in this deployment

features.title: Six screens, one thread from regulation to evidence
features.subtitle: Every number explains itself, and every claim links back to the paragraph it came from.

today.title: Today
today.desc: One readiness score for the day, with the overdue reports and pending approvals that are pulling it down.

alerts.title: Alerts and case files
alerts.desc: Each alert states its strongest reasons and the circular paragraph behind it, then builds a sealed evidence pack.

ask.title: Ask Kavach
ask.desc: Ask in plain English or Hindi. Verified queries answer straight from the data, with citations and the SQL on show.

rings.title: Mule rings
rings.desc: Accounts that pass money between themselves and share devices or phone numbers, drawn as one group.

rulebook.title: Rulebook
rulebook.desc: Circulars compiled into obligations and executable checks. Nothing runs until a person approves it.

timeMachine.title: Time Machine
timeMachine.desc: Move a threshold and replay 90 days to see the extra fraud caught and the extra work created.

closing.title: See it on a full dataset.
closing.body: Sign in as a compliance administrator, an analyst, an internal auditor or an external reviewer. Each role sees exactly what its masking policies allow — no more.

landing.footerNote: The circulars are regulator-style documents written for this demo. They follow the style of real regulator circulars but are not actual RBI circulars.

login.title: Sign in to KAVACH

login.subtitleTour: Sign in and the guided tour starts on the Today screen.
login.masking: Sign-in is real: the server opens a Snowflake session with these details, so the masking and row-access policies for your role apply to everything you see.

personas.note: For this demo every persona uses the password “password”.

tm.method: The replay runs the rule's real check on the last {{days}} days of data, at today's limit and at the new one. Fraud caught counts accounts that were planted as fraud in the synthetic data. Review hours assume 45 minutes per alert.
tm.methodDemo: Demo data: these numbers come from a built-in model of each check, not a replay on real data. Review hours assume 45 minutes per alert.
